Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.185), which favours a robust combination.

decision.justification: Selected 'dba' (an agent proposal) as the best of 11 backtested attempts, score 0.9705. Series context: trend strength 0.0325 and seasonal strength 0.6021; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.185); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.295.
